thread:
incident-bot: SEV-2 | AtlasBank (enterprise-VPC) reporting elevated 5xxs and missing traces for tenant_id=atlasbank-001. Pager sent to oncall-elena :rotating_light:

oncall-elena: Ack. I'm on it. Can someone confirm customer impact and whether this is only traces/logs or also request failures?

sre-raj: customer is seeing increased inference latency and occasional 503s from dedicated pool 'dedicated-east-2-a'. But most visible issue is we can't see full traces or logs for their requests in the tenant log-silo. Metrics show p95 latency spike from 180ms -> 1.2s for that tenant.

eng-runtime-maria: digging in runtime logs now. Initial look: requests are hitting the pool but trace ids aren't being emitted to our tracing backend for requests tagged with tenant_id=atlasbank-001. Logs are present in the local node, but forwarder fails during partition mapping step.

eng-infra-sam: that forwarder failure rings a bell — we rolled a change last night to log-silo routing to improve cost isolation. Could be a partition key mismatch. Pulling config.

eng-platform-lin: also seeing 403 when attempting to fetch AtlasBank's KMS-wrapped forwarding credentials. Could be KMS key policy blocking cross-account read.

oncall-elena: key asks: is customer traffic actually failing, or just we can't observe it? We need to prioritize both customer-facing mitigations and restore observability.

atlasbank-sre-marta: FYI we're getting alerts and customers seeing slow responses. We can provide request IDs if that helps. ETA for visibility would help.

eng-runtime-maria: please paste a sample request id, Marta. Also capture the node host if available.

atlasbank-sre-marta: request-id=rc-20260315-49a2, host hinted in header x-forwarded-host: rb-infer-03-east.

eng-runtime-maria: thanks. Found the request in node-local logs: trace id present locally but not ingested upstream. Stack shows error at log-forwarder during partition_lookup: 
```
PartitionLookupError: no_partition_found_for(tenant=atlasbank-001)
 at Router.assignPartition (/srv/log-forwarder/index.js:412)
 at process.nextTick...
```

eng-infra-sam: confirmed — our recent routing table change renamed the partition key from `tenant` -> `customer_id` in the config for the east region. Old-forwarder still emits `tenant` and new-router expects `customer_id`. So keys don't match and logs are dropped.

security-ops-kim: any quick workaround that doesn't involve keys rotation? KMS changes are high-friction for enterprise VPCs.

eng-platform-lin: We can temporarily enable legacy partition aliasing in the router to accept both `tenant` and `customer_id`. That is a config flip on the control plane and should not touch KMS. I can push a config change to the east region.

eng-infra-sam: to be safe, we should also enable passthrough of raw logs to a quarantine bucket for AtlasBank to preserve evidence while we fix routing. That requires a write policy but we can use our infra-sa key (no KMS rotation).

oncall-elena: Prioritize: 1) Restore observability (make traces/logs ingested) 2) Mitigate customer-facing latency if correlated 3) Update customer with ETA.

eng-platform-lin: I'm preparing the config flip now. Rolling to control-plane -> east region. Target start: +6m. Will monitor ingestion metrics for tenant `atlasbank-001`.

eng-runtime-maria: parallel step: add temporary verbose logging for requests from that tenant on the runtime nodes and push to node-local disk to avoid forwarder drop. Command below to enable on nodes in pool 'dedicated-east-2-a':
```bash
# enable tenant verbose logging (hot config)
curl -X POST "http://runtime-api.local/_hot_config" -d '{"tenant_verbose": ["atlasbank-001"]}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

oncall-elena: can infra and platform coordinate so change is atomic? Don't want duplicate partial states.

eng-infra-sam: I'll hold off the quarantine bucket write until platform confirms config flip success.

eng-platform-lin: config pushed (control-plane change id cp-20260315-07). Starting rollout to east region. Monitoring logs_ingest.success_rate for partition alias 'atlasbank-001' now.

incident-bot: Deploy started: cp-20260315-07 -> east-region (3/3 nodes). Live logs at https://deploys.redwood.internal/cp-20260315-07

5m later...

eng-platform-lin: ingestion success rate for atlasbank-001 back to 99.8% on first node, propagating to others. Traces starting to appear in X-Ray ingest.

eng-runtime-maria: verified request rc-20260315-49a2 now shows full span chain in tracing UI. Latency for same request improved slightly as some retry hotspots were due to missing KV cache warmup caused by lack of trace context propagation.

atlasbank-sre-marta: we see traces again and errors are reduced. Thanks. We'll watch for a bit and revert any internal alert throttles.

oncall-elena: customer update: "We deployed a config fix to accept legacy partition keys; traces/logs ingestion restored. We're continuing monitoring. No code change needed by AtlasBank. We'll keep you posted. ETA for full verification: 60m." @atlasbank-sre-marta does that work for you?

atlasbank-sre-marta: good enough, thx. Please share any request-ids we can watch.

customer-success-jake: I'll follow up on the support ticket and draft a postmortem for the customer. We'll offer a post-incident review and a commitment to a config compatibility test in staging.

security-ops-kim: note: because we didn't rotate KMS keys or change credentials, no additional security review required. But we should document the temporary alias and audit it.

eng-infra-sam: created a quarantine copy for the time window 2026-03-15T14:00-15:15 in gs://quarantine/atlasbank-001/rc-20260315. No sensitive keys touched.

eng-platform-lin: next steps: 1) revert alias after we deploy a more robust partition migration tool (owner: eng-platform-lin, ETA 72h) 2) add a config validation CI job to detect key name mismatches (owner: eng-infra-sam, ETA 48h) 3) run end-to-end test in staging with AtlasBank's tenant config (owner: customer-success-jake + eng-runtime-maria, ETA 48h).

oncall-elena: I'm handing off to next on-call (oncall-next) at 15:30 UTC. I'll file a short incident summary and assign follow-ups in the incident tracker.

incident-bot: Hand-off recorded. Next on-call: oncall-bryan. Incident state: mitigated (observability restored) — monitoring 60m.

oncall-elena: Documentation + short blameless note: the root cause was a config key rename in routing table during a control-plane rollout. It caused log-forwarder partition lookup to fail for legacy key `tenant`. Resolved by enabling partition aliasing; follow-ups above.

eng-runtime-maria: small code patch proposed to include both keys in emitted envelope to avoid future single-point mismatches. Will open PR and run tests.

customer-success-jake: will coordinate a customer postmortem and share timeline + mitigation steps with AtlasBank.

atlasbank-sre-marta: appreciate the quick response. We'll keep monitoring on our side and will escalate if we see regressions.

security-ops-kim: closing note: audit log entry created for the config flip cp-20260315-07. No policy violations.

oncall-elena: closing this thread for now — please add any follow-ups to the incident ticket #INC-20260315-92. Thanks team :heart:
